# Marks every Cold War GUI for re-evaluation.
mdcw_cw_touch_gui = {
	add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_gui_dirty = 1 }
}

# temp mdcw_cw_tension_delta
mdcw_cw_add_tension = {
	add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension = mdcw_cw_tension_delta }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_tension min = 0 max = 100 }
	mdcw_cw_update_tension_display = yes
	mdcw_cw_touch_gui = yes
}

mdcw_cw_update_tension_display = {
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bar_tension = global.mdcw_cw_tension }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bar_tension = 3 }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bar_tension = 300 }
	round_variable = global.mdcw_cw_bar_tension
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_tension value = 80 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension_tier = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_tension value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension_tier = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_tension value = 40 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension_tier = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_tension value = 20 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension_tier = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_tension value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension_tier = 1 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Runs once per country (startup, later for released or new tags).
mdcw_cw_setup_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } }
		set_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
		mdcw_cw_update_bloc_value = yes
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject = yes
				overlord = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
			}
			overlord = { set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_al = mdcw_cw_alignment } }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = mdcw_cw_t_al }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_startup_running }

				}
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 }

					OR = {
					original_tag = SOV

					original_tag = VIE

					}
				}
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
					original_tag = CHI
					original_tag = ALB
					}
				}
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 }

		}
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_type = 1 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_size = 1 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_party = 1 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_used = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_cost_monthly = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_mil_prog_out = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_pp_gain = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_out = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_in = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_lock_until = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_lock_left = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_construction = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_construction = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_construction = 0 }

		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_research = 0 }

		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_productivity = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_consumer = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_consumer = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_consumer = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_training = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_training = 0 }

		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_army_xp = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_army_xp = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_army_xp = 0 }

		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_bureaucracy = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_bureaucracy = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_bureaucracy = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_program_modifier } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_program_modifier }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_world_market_modifier } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_world_market_modifier }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_great_power_competition } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_great_power_competition }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_modifier_na } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_modifier_na }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_modifier_west } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_modifier_west }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_modifier_soviet } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_modifier_soviet }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_modifier_beijing } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_modifier_beijing }
		}
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
		mdcw_cw_update_send_preview = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Bloc points follow the MD power rank (recalculated monthly by MD).
mdcw_cw_update_bloc_value = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = super_power }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_value = 20 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_rank = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = great_power }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_value = 12 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_rank = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = large_power }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_value = 7 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_rank = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = regional_power }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_value = 4 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_rank = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = minor_power }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_value = 2 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_rank = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = non_power }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_value = 1 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_rank = 6 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_value = 1 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_rank = 0 }
	}
}

# Sender scope. Preview values for the assistance send window (independent of the target).
mdcw_cw_update_send_preview = {
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_cost = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_type = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_cost = 0.4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_type = 2 } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_cost = 0.3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_type = 3 } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_cost = 0.5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_type = 4 } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_cost = 0.3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_type = 5 } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_cost = 0.6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_type = 6 } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_cost = 0.3 }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_mpc = 1 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_mpc = modifier@mdcw_cw_military_programme_cost }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_mpc min = 0 }
		multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_cost = mdcw_cw_t_mpc }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_type = 7 } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_cost = 0.4 }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_mpc = 1 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_mpc = modifier@mdcw_cw_military_programme_cost }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_mpc min = 0 }
		multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_cost = mdcw_cw_t_mpc }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_type = 8 } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_cost = 0.2 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_send_size }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = 0.5 }
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_cost = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_cost_opp = mdcw_cw_send_cost }
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_cost_opp = 1.5 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_cost_weekly = mdcw_cw_send_cost }
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_cost_weekly = 12 }
	divide_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_cost_weekly = 52 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_cost_opp_weekly = mdcw_cw_send_cost_opp }
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_cost_opp_weekly = 12 }
	divide_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_cost_opp_weekly = 52 }
}

# Player scope. Called when the window opens or a tab changes, so the numbers
# on screen are current without any daily loop.
mdcw_cw_refresh_player_view = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { mdcw_cw_out^num > 0 }
					check_variable = { mdcw_cw_in^num > 0 }
				}
			}
			mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes
		}
		else = {
			mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
			mdcw_cw_calculate_switch_costs = yes
		}
		# Remaining days of programmes we receive (stored on the donors).
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = mdcw_cw_in
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_size@PREV > 0 } }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_left@PREV = mdcw_cw_p1_end@PREV }
				subtract_from_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_left@PREV = global.num_days }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_size@PREV > 0 } }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_left@PREV = mdcw_cw_p2_end@PREV }
				subtract_from_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_left@PREV = global.num_days }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_size@PREV > 0 } }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_left@PREV = mdcw_cw_p3_end@PREV }
				subtract_from_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_left@PREV = global.num_days }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p4_size@PREV > 0 } }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p4_left@PREV = mdcw_cw_p4_end@PREV }
				subtract_from_variable = { mdcw_cw_p4_left@PREV = global.num_days }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p5_size@PREV > 0 } }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p5_left@PREV = mdcw_cw_p5_end@PREV }
				subtract_from_variable = { mdcw_cw_p5_left@PREV = global.num_days }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p6_size@PREV > 0 } }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p6_left@PREV = mdcw_cw_p6_end@PREV }
				subtract_from_variable = { mdcw_cw_p6_left@PREV = global.num_days }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p7_size@PREV > 0 } }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p7_left@PREV = mdcw_cw_p7_end@PREV }
				subtract_from_variable = { mdcw_cw_p7_left@PREV = global.num_days }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p8_size@PREV > 0 } }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p8_left@PREV = mdcw_cw_p8_end@PREV }
				subtract_from_variable = { mdcw_cw_p8_left@PREV = global.num_days }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_party@PREV > 0 } }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_left@PREV = mdcw_cw_pps_end@PREV }
				subtract_from_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_left@PREV = global.num_days }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_lock_left = mdcw_cw_lock_until }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdcw_cw_lock_left = global.num_days }
		clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_lock_left min = 0 max = 99999 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_estranged_left = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_estranged }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_estranged_left = mdcw_cw_estranged_until }
			subtract_from_variable = { mdcw_cw_estranged_left = global.num_days }
			clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_estranged_left min = 0 max = 99999 }
		}
		mdcw_cw_update_send_preview = yes
	}
	mdcw_cw_update_programme_days = yes
	mdcw_cw_update_oil_display = yes
}


# Global. Called from on_startup inside the USA scope (1970 only).
mdcw_cw_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } }
		set_global_flag = mdcw_cw_startup_running
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension = 45 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = 1 }
		mdcw_cw_update_cpi = yes
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_gui_dirty = 0 }
		every_country = {
			mdcw_cw_setup_country = yes
		}
		clr_global_flag = mdcw_cw_startup_running
		set_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
		mdcw_cw_update_tension_display = yes
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_all = yes
		# Power ranks and GDP of the 1970 setup settle during startup: recount once on day 2.
		country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.1 days = 1 }
	}
}
# Global. Rebuilds blocs and every country's values (startup and the hidden day-2 event).
mdcw_cw_recalculate_all = {
	mdcw_cw_rebuild_blocs = yes
	mdcw_cw_update_world_situation = yes
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes
		mdcw_cw_update_bloc_effects = yes
		mdcw_cw_update_world_market = yes
	}
	mdcw_cw_touch_gui = yes
}

# Global. Rebuilds member lists and bloc strength from scratch (self-healing).
# The member lists are filled strongest rank first, so the interface shows them sorted.
mdcw_cw_rebuild_blocs = {
	clear_array = global.mdcw_cw_members_na
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_power_0 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_count_0 = 0 }
	clear_array = global.mdcw_cw_members_west
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_power_1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_count_1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_core_1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_estranged_1 = 0 }
	clear_array = global.mdcw_cw_members_soviet
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_power_2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_count_2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_core_2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_estranged_2 = 0 }
	clear_array = global.mdcw_cw_members_beijing
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_power_3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_count_3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_core_3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_estranged_3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_mil_programs = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
		mdcw_cw_update_bloc_value = yes
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_pts = mdcw_cw_bloc_value }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_estranged }
			multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_pts = 0.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
			add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_power_0 = mdcw_cw_bloc_pts }
			add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_count_0 = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
			add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_power_1 = mdcw_cw_bloc_pts }
			add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_count_1 = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_estranged }
				add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_estranged_1 = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { mdcw_cw_party_core_west = yes }
				add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_core_1 = mdcw_cw_bloc_pts }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
			add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_power_2 = mdcw_cw_bloc_pts }
			add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_count_2 = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_estranged }
				add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_estranged_2 = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { mdcw_cw_party_core_soviet = yes }
				add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_core_2 = mdcw_cw_bloc_pts }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 } }
			add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_power_3 = mdcw_cw_bloc_pts }
			add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_count_3 = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_estranged }
				add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_estranged_3 = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { mdcw_cw_party_core_beijing = yes }
				add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_core_3 = mdcw_cw_bloc_pts }
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_mil_programs = mdcw_cw_mil_prog_out }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_value = 20 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_na = THIS.id }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_west = THIS.id }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_soviet = THIS.id }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_beijing = THIS.id }
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_value = 12 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_na = THIS.id }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_west = THIS.id }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_soviet = THIS.id }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_beijing = THIS.id }
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_value = 7 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_na = THIS.id }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_west = THIS.id }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_soviet = THIS.id }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_beijing = THIS.id }
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_value = 4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_na = THIS.id }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_west = THIS.id }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_soviet = THIS.id }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_beijing = THIS.id }
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_na = THIS.id }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_west = THIS.id }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_soviet = THIS.id }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_beijing = THIS.id }
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_na = THIS.id }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_west = THIS.id }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_soviet = THIS.id }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 } }
			add_to_array = { global.mdcw_cw_members_beijing = THIS.id }
		}
	}
	mdcw_cw_update_bloc_weights = yes
	mdcw_cw_count_bloc_sanctions = yes
	mdcw_cw_touch_gui = yes
}

# Global. Share of world power, network scale, tiers and card values of every bloc.
mdcw_cw_update_bloc_weights = {
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_power_total = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_power_total = global.mdcw_cw_power_0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_power_total = global.mdcw_cw_power_1 }
	add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_power_total = global.mdcw_cw_power_2 }
	add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_power_total = global.mdcw_cw_power_3 }
	# Non-Aligned
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_share_0 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_power_total > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_share_0 = global.mdcw_cw_power_0 }
		divide_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_share_0 = global.mdcw_cw_power_total }
	}
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_share_pct_0 = global.mdcw_cw_share_0 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_share_pct_0 = 100 }
	round_variable = global.mdcw_cw_share_pct_0
	# Network scale: linear up to the knee, half as fast above it.
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_a = global.mdcw_cw_share_0 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_a min = 0 max = 0.25 }
	divide_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_a = 0.25 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_b = global.mdcw_cw_share_0 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_b = 0.25 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_b min = 0 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_b = 2 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_a = mdcw_cw_t_b }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_a min = 0 max = 1.75 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_scale_0 = mdcw_cw_t_a }
	# Bar on the bloc card
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bar_bloc_0 = global.mdcw_cw_share_0 }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_bar_bloc_0 min = 0 max = 0.6 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bar_bloc_0 = 266.6667 }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bar_bloc_0 = 160 }
	round_variable = global.mdcw_cw_bar_bloc_0
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_0_network_pp_factor = 0.05 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_0_network_pp_factor = global.mdcw_cw_scale_0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_0_network_fidef = 0.05 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_0_network_fidef = global.mdcw_cw_scale_0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_0_network_sanc_res = 0.05 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_0_network_sanc_res = global.mdcw_cw_scale_0 }
	# Western Bloc
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_share_1 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_power_total > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_share_1 = global.mdcw_cw_power_1 }
		divide_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_share_1 = global.mdcw_cw_power_total }
	}
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_share_pct_1 = global.mdcw_cw_share_1 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_share_pct_1 = 100 }
	round_variable = global.mdcw_cw_share_pct_1
	# Network scale: linear up to the knee, half as fast above it.
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_a = global.mdcw_cw_share_1 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_a min = 0 max = 0.25 }
	divide_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_a = 0.25 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_b = global.mdcw_cw_share_1 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_b = 0.25 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_b min = 0 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_b = 2 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_a = mdcw_cw_t_b }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_a min = 0 max = 1.75 }
	# Cohesion: members with a core ideology make the bloc stronger.
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_core_share_1 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_power_1 > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_core_share_1 = global.mdcw_cw_core_1 }
		divide_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_core_share_1 = global.mdcw_cw_power_1 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_core_share_1 min = 0 max = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_core_pct_1 = global.mdcw_cw_core_share_1 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_core_pct_1 = 100 }
	round_variable = global.mdcw_cw_core_pct_1
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cohesion_1 = global.mdcw_cw_core_share_1 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cohesion_1 = 0.3 }
	add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cohesion_1 = 0.85 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_a = global.mdcw_cw_cohesion_1 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_scale_1 = mdcw_cw_t_a }
	# Bar on the bloc card
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bar_bloc_1 = global.mdcw_cw_share_1 }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_bar_bloc_1 min = 0 max = 0.6 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bar_bloc_1 = 266.6667 }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bar_bloc_1 = 160 }
	round_variable = global.mdcw_cw_bar_bloc_1
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_1_network_roi = 0.004 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_1_network_roi = global.mdcw_cw_scale_1 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_1_network_interest = -0.25 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_1_network_interest = global.mdcw_cw_scale_1 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_1_network_research = 0.02 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_1_network_research = global.mdcw_cw_scale_1 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_1_network_sanc_eff = 0.05 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_1_network_sanc_eff = global.mdcw_cw_scale_1 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_1_leader_pp_gain = 0.2 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_1_leader_pp_gain = global.mdcw_cw_scale_1 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_1_leader_sanc_eff = 0.1 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_1_leader_sanc_eff = global.mdcw_cw_scale_1 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_1_leader_interest = -0.25 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_1_leader_interest = global.mdcw_cw_scale_1 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_1_leader_army_pay = 0.03 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_1_leader_army_pay = global.mdcw_cw_scale_1 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_1 = global.mdcw_cw_power_1 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = USA }
		USA = { set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_lv = mdcw_cw_bloc_value } }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_1 = mdcw_cw_t_lv }
	}
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_1 = 0.005 }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_1 min = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_1_weekly = global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_1 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_1_weekly = 12 }
	divide_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_1_weekly = 52 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_share_1 value = 0.45 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_1 = 3 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_bonus_1 = 3 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_factor_1 = 1.15 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_share_1 value = 0.3 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_1 = 2 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_bonus_1 = 2 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_factor_1 = 1.1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_share_1 value = 0.15 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_1 = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_bonus_1 = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_factor_1 = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_share_1 value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_1 = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_bonus_1 = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_factor_1 = 1 }
	}
	# Soviet Bloc
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_share_2 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_power_total > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_share_2 = global.mdcw_cw_power_2 }
		divide_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_share_2 = global.mdcw_cw_power_total }
	}
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_share_pct_2 = global.mdcw_cw_share_2 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_share_pct_2 = 100 }
	round_variable = global.mdcw_cw_share_pct_2
	# Network scale: linear up to the knee, half as fast above it.
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_a = global.mdcw_cw_share_2 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_a min = 0 max = 0.25 }
	divide_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_a = 0.25 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_b = global.mdcw_cw_share_2 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_b = 0.25 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_b min = 0 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_b = 2 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_a = mdcw_cw_t_b }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_a min = 0 max = 1.75 }
	# Cohesion: members with a core ideology make the bloc stronger.
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_core_share_2 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_power_2 > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_core_share_2 = global.mdcw_cw_core_2 }
		divide_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_core_share_2 = global.mdcw_cw_power_2 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_core_share_2 min = 0 max = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_core_pct_2 = global.mdcw_cw_core_share_2 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_core_pct_2 = 100 }
	round_variable = global.mdcw_cw_core_pct_2
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cohesion_2 = global.mdcw_cw_core_share_2 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cohesion_2 = 0.3 }
	add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cohesion_2 = 0.85 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_a = global.mdcw_cw_cohesion_2 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_scale_2 = mdcw_cw_t_a }
	# Bar on the bloc card
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bar_bloc_2 = global.mdcw_cw_share_2 }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_bar_bloc_2 min = 0 max = 0.6 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bar_bloc_2 = 266.6667 }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bar_bloc_2 = 160 }
	round_variable = global.mdcw_cw_bar_bloc_2
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_2_network_oil_res = 0.1 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_2_network_oil_res = global.mdcw_cw_scale_2 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_2_network_equip = -0.05 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_2_network_equip = global.mdcw_cw_scale_2 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_2_network_eff_gain = 0.03 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_2_network_eff_gain = global.mdcw_cw_scale_2 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_2_network_prod_growth = -0.03 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_2_network_prod_growth = global.mdcw_cw_scale_2 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_2_leader_pp_gain = 0.2 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_2_leader_pp_gain = global.mdcw_cw_scale_2 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_2_leader_ic = 0.02 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_2_leader_ic = global.mdcw_cw_scale_2 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_2_leader_sanc_eff = 0.05 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_2_leader_sanc_eff = global.mdcw_cw_scale_2 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_2_leader_oil_exp = -0.05 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_2_leader_oil_exp = global.mdcw_cw_scale_2 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_2 = global.mdcw_cw_power_2 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = SOV }
		SOV = { set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_lv = mdcw_cw_bloc_value } }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_2 = mdcw_cw_t_lv }
	}
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_2 = 0.01 }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_2 min = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_2_weekly = global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_2 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_2_weekly = 12 }
	divide_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_2_weekly = 52 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_share_2 value = 0.45 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_2 = 3 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_bonus_2 = 3 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_factor_2 = 1.15 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_share_2 value = 0.3 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_2 = 2 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_bonus_2 = 2 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_factor_2 = 1.1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_share_2 value = 0.15 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_2 = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_bonus_2 = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_factor_2 = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_share_2 value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_2 = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_bonus_2 = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_factor_2 = 1 }
	}
	# Beijing Camp
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_share_3 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_power_total > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_share_3 = global.mdcw_cw_power_3 }
		divide_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_share_3 = global.mdcw_cw_power_total }
	}
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_share_pct_3 = global.mdcw_cw_share_3 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_share_pct_3 = 100 }
	round_variable = global.mdcw_cw_share_pct_3
	# Network scale: linear up to the knee, half as fast above it.
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_a = global.mdcw_cw_share_3 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_a min = 0 max = 0.25 }
	divide_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_a = 0.25 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_b = global.mdcw_cw_share_3 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_b = 0.25 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_b min = 0 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_b = 2 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_a = mdcw_cw_t_b }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_a min = 0 max = 1.75 }
	# Cohesion: members with a core ideology make the bloc stronger.
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_core_share_3 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_power_3 > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_core_share_3 = global.mdcw_cw_core_3 }
		divide_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_core_share_3 = global.mdcw_cw_power_3 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_core_share_3 min = 0 max = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_core_pct_3 = global.mdcw_cw_core_share_3 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_core_pct_3 = 100 }
	round_variable = global.mdcw_cw_core_pct_3
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cohesion_3 = global.mdcw_cw_core_share_3 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cohesion_3 = 0.3 }
	add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cohesion_3 = 0.85 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_a = global.mdcw_cw_cohesion_3 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_scale_3 = mdcw_cw_t_a }
	# Bar on the bloc card
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bar_bloc_3 = global.mdcw_cw_share_3 }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_bar_bloc_3 min = 0 max = 0.6 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bar_bloc_3 = 266.6667 }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bar_bloc_3 = 160 }
	round_variable = global.mdcw_cw_bar_bloc_3
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_3_network_build = 0.04 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_3_network_build = global.mdcw_cw_scale_3 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_3_network_train = -0.05 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_3_network_train = global.mdcw_cw_scale_3 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_3_network_stab = -0.02 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_3_network_stab = global.mdcw_cw_scale_3 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_3_leader_pp_gain = 0.15 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_3_leader_pp_gain = global.mdcw_cw_scale_3 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_3_leader_war_sup = 0.03 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_3_leader_war_sup = global.mdcw_cw_scale_3 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_3_leader_consumer = 0.02 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_fx_3_leader_consumer = global.mdcw_cw_scale_3 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_3 = global.mdcw_cw_power_3 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = CHI }
		CHI = { set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_lv = mdcw_cw_bloc_value } }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_3 = mdcw_cw_t_lv }
	}
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_3 = 0.008 }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_3 min = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_3_weekly = global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_3 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_3_weekly = 12 }
	divide_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_3_weekly = 52 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_share_3 value = 0.45 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_3 = 3 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_bonus_3 = 3 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_factor_3 = 1.15 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_share_3 value = 0.3 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_3 = 2 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_bonus_3 = 2 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_factor_3 = 1.1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_share_3 value = 0.15 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_3 = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_bonus_3 = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_factor_3 = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_share_3 value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_3 = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_bonus_3 = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tier_factor_3 = 1 }
	}
}

# Global. Counts Imperia sanctions between two opposing blocs (read only; the sanction
# system itself is untouched). THIS = sanctioning country, PREV = sanctioned country.
mdcw_cw_count_bloc_sanctions = {
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_x_sanctions = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_x_econ = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 }
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
					mdcw_cw_opposing_to_prev = yes
				}
				add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_x_sanctions = 1 }
			}
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
					mdcw_cw_opposing_to_prev = yes
				}
				add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_x_sanctions = 1 }
				add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_x_econ = 1 }
			}
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
					mdcw_cw_opposing_to_prev = yes
				}
				add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_x_sanctions = 1 }
				add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_x_econ = 1 }
			}
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
					mdcw_cw_opposing_to_prev = yes
				}
				add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_x_sanctions = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	# Sanctions between the blocs keep the climate cold: they raise the tension baseline.
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension_baseline_add = global.mdcw_cw_x_sanctions }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension_baseline_add = 0.1 }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_tension_baseline_add min = 0 max = 8 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension_baseline = 40 }
	add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension_baseline = global.mdcw_cw_tension_baseline_add }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension_baseline_low = global.mdcw_cw_tension_baseline }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension_baseline_low = 2 }
}

# Country scope. Recomputes the bloc membership modifier (profile + network x scale,
# leadership x scale and upkeep for bloc leaders, active leader programmes).
mdcw_cw_update_bloc_effects = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_modifier_na } } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_modifier_na }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_modifier_west } } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_modifier_west }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_modifier_soviet } } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_modifier_soviet }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_modifier_beijing } } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_modifier_beijing }
	}
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_trade = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_glob = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_fidef = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_drift_west = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_drift_emerging = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_roi = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_interest = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_research = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_sanc_res = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_sanc_eff = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_pp_gain = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_pp_factor = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_army_pay = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_mil_pay = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_stab = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_war_sup = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_oil_res = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_equip = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_eff_gain = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_prod_growth = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_ic = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_oil_exp = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_build = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_train = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_consumer = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_upkeep = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
		# Western Bloc: profile
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_trade = 0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_glob = 5 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_fidef = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_mil_pay = 0.03 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_oil_res = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_drift_west = 0.02 }
		# network, scaled by the bloc's share of world power (half for estranged members)
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_scale = global.mdcw_cw_scale_1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_estranged }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_scale = 0.5 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.004 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_t_scale }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_roi = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.25 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_t_scale }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_interest = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.02 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_t_scale }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_research = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.05 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_t_scale }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_sanc_eff = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		if = {
			limit = { original_tag = USA }
			# leadership, scaled
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.2 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = global.mdcw_cw_scale_1 }
			add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_pp_gain = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.1 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = global.mdcw_cw_scale_1 }
			add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_sanc_eff = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.25 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = global.mdcw_cw_scale_1 }
			add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_interest = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.03 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = global.mdcw_cw_scale_1 }
			add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_army_pay = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_upkeep = global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_1 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_bp_1 }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_interest = 0.25 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_bp_1
				NOT = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_estranged }
			}
			add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_interest = -0.5 }
			add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_roi = 0.003 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
		# Soviet Bloc: profile
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_sanc_res = 0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_stab = 0.02 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_glob = -10 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_roi = -0.005 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_trade = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_drift_emerging = 0.02 }
		# network, scaled by the bloc's share of world power (half for estranged members)
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_scale = global.mdcw_cw_scale_2 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_estranged }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_scale = 0.5 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.1 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_t_scale }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_oil_res = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.05 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_t_scale }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_equip = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.03 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_t_scale }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_eff_gain = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.03 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_t_scale }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_prod_growth = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		if = {
			limit = { original_tag = SOV }
			# leadership, scaled
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.2 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = global.mdcw_cw_scale_2 }
			add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_pp_gain = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.02 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = global.mdcw_cw_scale_2 }
			add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_ic = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.05 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = global.mdcw_cw_scale_2 }
			add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_sanc_eff = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.05 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = global.mdcw_cw_scale_2 }
			add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_oil_exp = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_upkeep = global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_2 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_bp_2 }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_oil_exp = -0.05 }
				multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_upkeep = 1.5 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_bp_2
				NOT = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_estranged }
			}
			add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_eff_gain = 0.05 }
			add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_oil_res = 0.1 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 } }
		# Beijing Camp: profile
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_fidef = 0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_sanc_res = 0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_war_sup = 0.03 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_glob = -15 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_trade = -0.15 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_research = -0.02 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_drift_emerging = 0.02 }
		# network, scaled by the bloc's share of world power (half for estranged members)
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_scale = global.mdcw_cw_scale_3 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_estranged }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_scale = 0.5 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.04 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_t_scale }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_build = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.05 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_t_scale }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_train = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.02 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_t_scale }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_stab = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		if = {
			limit = { original_tag = CHI }
			# leadership, scaled
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.15 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = global.mdcw_cw_scale_3 }
			add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_pp_gain = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.03 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = global.mdcw_cw_scale_3 }
			add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_war_sup = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.02 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = global.mdcw_cw_scale_3 }
			add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_consumer = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_upkeep = global.mdcw_cw_upkeep_3 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_bp_3 }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_consumer = 0.02 }
				multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_upkeep = 1.5 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_bp_3
				NOT = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_estranged }
			}
			add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_build = 0.05 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		# Non-Aligned: profile
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_fidef = 0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_trade = 0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_research = -0.01 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_equip = 0.03 }
		# network, scaled by the bloc's share of world power (half for estranged members)
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_scale = global.mdcw_cw_scale_0 }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.05 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_t_scale }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_pp_factor = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.05 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_t_scale }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_fidef = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.05 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_t_scale }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_b_sanc_res = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
	}
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_upkeep_weekly = mdcw_cw_bloc_upkeep }
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_upkeep_weekly = 12 }
	divide_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_upkeep_weekly = 52 }
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

# Global. Every country, after shares or leader programmes changed.
mdcw_cw_refresh_all_bloc_effects = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
		mdcw_cw_update_bloc_effects = yes
	}
}

### Oil shocks ###
# Global. US consumer price index relative to 1970 (annual averages, BLS CPI-U).
mdcw_cw_update_cpi = {
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1991.1.1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 3.5103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date > 1990.1.1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 3.3686 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date > 1989.1.1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 3.1959 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date > 1988.1.1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 3.049 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date > 1987.1.1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 2.9278 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date > 1986.1.1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 2.8247 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date > 1985.1.1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 2.7732 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date > 1984.1.1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 2.6778 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date > 1983.1.1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 2.567 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date > 1982.1.1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 2.4871 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date > 1981.1.1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 2.3428 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date > 1980.1.1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 2.1237 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date > 1979.1.1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 1.8711 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date > 1978.1.1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 1.6804 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date > 1977.1.1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 1.5619 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date > 1976.1.1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 1.4665 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date > 1975.1.1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 1.3866 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date > 1974.1.1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 1.2706 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date > 1973.1.1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 1.1443 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date > 1972.1.1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 1.0773 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { date > 1971.1.1 }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 1.0438 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_cpi = 1 }
	}
}

# Global. Share of world oil exports under active producer price agreements.
mdcw_cw_update_opec_share = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_oil_all = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_oil_opec = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_oil_cut = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_count = 0 }
	every_country = { limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_out > 0 } } set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_export_share = 0 } set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct = 0 } }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.major_oil_exporters
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { imp_oil_export_surplus > 0 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_oil_all = imp_oil_export_surplus }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_price_agreement }
				add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_oil_opec = imp_oil_export_surplus }
				add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_count = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_price_cut }
				add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_oil_cut = imp_oil_export_surplus }
			}
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.minor_oil_exporters
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { imp_oil_export_surplus > 0 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_oil_all = imp_oil_export_surplus }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_price_agreement }
				add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_oil_opec = imp_oil_export_surplus }
				add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_count = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_price_cut }
				add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_oil_cut = imp_oil_export_surplus }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_export_total = mdcw_cw_t_oil_all }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.major_oil_exporters
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_export_share = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { imp_oil_export_surplus > 0 } check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_export_total > 0 } }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_export_share = imp_oil_export_surplus }
			divide_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_export_share = global.mdcw_cw_oil_export_total }
		}
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share }
		multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct = 100 }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.minor_oil_exporters
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_export_share = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { imp_oil_export_surplus > 0 } check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_export_total > 0 } }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_export_share = imp_oil_export_surplus }
			divide_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_export_share = global.mdcw_cw_oil_export_total }
		}
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share }
		multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_export_pct = 100 }
	}
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_share = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_oil_all > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_share = mdcw_cw_t_oil_opec }
		divide_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_share = mdcw_cw_t_oil_all }
	}
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_cut_share = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_oil_all > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_cut_share = mdcw_cw_t_oil_cut }
		divide_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_cut_share = mdcw_cw_t_oil_all }
	}
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_pct = global.mdcw_cw_opec_share }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_pct = 100 }
	round_variable = global.mdcw_cw_opec_pct
}

# Global. Real oil price ratio to January 1970 (without embargo shortages).
mdcw_cw_update_oil_ratio = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_oil_level } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio = global.mdcw_cw_oil_level }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.imp_global_oil_price }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio = global.imp_global_oil_price }
		divide_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio = 75 }
		multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio = global.mdcw_cw_oil_level }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_world_multiplier }
		multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio = global.mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_world_multiplier }
	}
}

# Global, monthly. Producer prices follow agreements and market demand.
mdcw_cw_update_oil_level = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_oil_level } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = 1 }
	}
	mdcw_cw_update_cpi = yes
	mdcw_cw_update_opec_share = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_opec_share value = 0.25 compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_share > global.mdcw_cw_opec_cut_share } }
		# Creep towards the OPEC line's target level
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_target = global.mdcw_cw_opec_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_target = 0.8 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_target = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level < mdcw_cw_t_target } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_f = global.mdcw_cw_opec_share }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_f = 0.015 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_f = 1 }
			multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = mdcw_cw_t_f }
		}
		# Tight market: the posted price follows the market up
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.imp_global_oil_price > 100 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_f = global.imp_global_oil_price }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_f = 100 }
			divide_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_f = 75 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_f = global.mdcw_cw_opec_share }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_f = 1 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_f = 1 }
			multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = mdcw_cw_t_f }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_opec_cut_share value = 0.25 compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_cut_share > global.mdcw_cw_opec_share } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cut_target = global.mdcw_cw_opec_cut_share }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cut_target = 0.5 }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_one = 1 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_one = mdcw_cw_t_cut_target }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level > mdcw_cw_t_one } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_f = global.mdcw_cw_opec_cut_share }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_f = 0.015 }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_one = 1 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_one = mdcw_cw_t_f }
			multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = mdcw_cw_t_one }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level > 1 } }
			multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = 0.995 }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level < 1 } }
			multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = 1.005 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level > 3 } }
		multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = 0.996 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_oil_level min = 0.5 max = 12 }
	mdcw_cw_update_oil_ratio = yes
	imp_update_oil_price_display = yes
}

# Target scope. Embargo weight is the sum of embargoing producers' actual world export shares.
mdcw_cw_recalculate_oil_embargo_pressure = {
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_in = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_pressure = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_sources
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_in = 1 } }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_pressure = PREV.mdcw_cw_oil_export_share } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_source_share = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_pressure }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_import_dependency = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { resource_consumed@oil > resource_produced@oil } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_import_dependency = resource_consumed@oil }
		subtract_from_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_import_dependency = resource_produced@oil }
		divide_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_import_dependency = resource_consumed@oil }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_pressure min = 0 max = 0.8 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_pressure_pct = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_pressure }
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_pressure_pct = 100 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_cost_pct = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_pressure_pct }
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_cost_pct = 1.2 }
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_cost_pct = mdcw_cw_oil_import_dependency }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = mdcw_ni_petroleum_reserve } multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_cost_pct = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { mdcw_cw_is_oil_exporter = yes } multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_cost_pct = 0.5 } }
}

# Global. Count each sender only up to its actual export surplus. Split each
# target's import demand by the coalition's export shares, and saturate at
# the target's total oil imports as more producers join.
# Cached once per policy change/month, never in the weekly money or price loops.
mdcw_cw_recalculate_oil_embargo_world = {
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_world_share = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_out > 0 } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_target_imports = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_lost_sales = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_targets
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_target_imports = resource_imported@oil }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_source_share > 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_source_fraction = PREV.mdcw_cw_oil_export_share }
					divide_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_source_fraction = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_source_share }
					multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_target_imports = mdcw_cw_t_source_fraction }
					set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_demand_coverage = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_source_share }
					divide_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_demand_coverage = 0.25 }
					clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_demand_coverage min = 0 max = 1 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_target_imports = mdcw_cw_t_demand_coverage }
				}
				else = { set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_target_imports = 0 } }
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_target_imports = mdcw_cw_t_target_imports } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { imp_oil_export_surplus > 0 } check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_export_total > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_disrupted = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_target_imports }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_disrupted min = 0 max = imp_oil_export_surplus }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_lost_sales = mdcw_cw_t_disrupted }
			divide_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_lost_sales = imp_oil_export_surplus }
			multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_lost_sales = 0.25 }
			divide_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_disrupted = global.mdcw_cw_oil_export_total }
			add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_world_share = mdcw_cw_t_disrupted }
		}
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_world_share min = 0 max = 0.75 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_world_pct = global.mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_world_share }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_world_pct = 100 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_world_multiplier = global.mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_world_share }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_world_multiplier = 0.25 }
	add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_world_multiplier = 1 }
	mdcw_cw_update_oil_ratio = yes
	imp_update_oil_price_display = yes
}

# Sender scope, PREV = chosen country.
mdcw_cw_start_oil_embargo = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_export_total > 0 } } } imp_calculate_oil_producers = yes }
	mdcw_cw_update_opec_share = yes
	add_to_array = { array = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_targets value = PREV }
	add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_out = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_oil_target = PREV.id }
	add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_oil_trade_embargo }
	PREV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_oil_trade_embargo } }
	PREV = {
		add_to_array = { array = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_sources value = PREV }
		set_country_flag = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_happened
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_oil_embargo_pressure = yes
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo }
	}
	mdcw_cw_recalculate_oil_embargo_world = yes
	mdcw_cw_update_world_situation = yes
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 1 }
	mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev13_partner = PREV.id }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev13_target = mdcw_cw_t_oil_target }
		news_event = { id = mdcw_cw.13 }
	}
	mdcw_cw_touch_gui = yes
}

# Sender scope, PREV = chosen country. Lift exactly this bilateral embargo.
mdcw_cw_end_oil_embargo = {
	remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_oil_trade_embargo }
	PREV = { remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_oil_trade_embargo } }
	remove_from_array = { array = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_targets value = PREV }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_out = 1 }
	clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_out min = 0 max = 99 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_out < 1 } } set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_lost_sales = 0 } }
	PREV = {
		remove_from_array = { array = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_sources value = PREV }
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_oil_embargo_pressure = yes
	}
	mdcw_cw_recalculate_oil_embargo_world = yes
	mdcw_cw_update_world_situation = yes
	mdcw_cw_touch_gui = yes
}

# Country scope, called by Imperia's oil formulas. temp imp_oil_factor_t: market price in;
# out: the price this country feels from world prices and bilateral embargo pressure.
mdcw_cw_oil_effective_price = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_oil_level }
		multiply_temp_variable = { imp_oil_factor_t = global.mdcw_cw_oil_level }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_world_multiplier }
		multiply_temp_variable = { imp_oil_factor_t = global.mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_world_multiplier }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_pressure > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_embargo_factor = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_pressure }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_embargo_factor = 1.2 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_embargo_factor = mdcw_cw_oil_import_dependency }
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = mdcw_ni_petroleum_reserve }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_embargo_factor = 0.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { mdcw_cw_is_oil_exporter = yes }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_embargo_factor = 0.5 }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_embargo_factor = 1 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { imp_oil_factor_t = mdcw_cw_t_embargo_factor }
	}
}

# Country scope, called by Imperia's high-price formula. temp imp_oil_factor_t = (price - 75) / 125.
# Export income uses the world price, not a target's local embargo surcharge.
# The import burden flattens above Imperia's range.
mdcw_cw_oil_consequence_factor = {
	set_temp_variable = { imp_oil_factor_exp_t = global.imp_global_oil_price }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_oil_level }
		multiply_temp_variable = { imp_oil_factor_exp_t = global.mdcw_cw_oil_level }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_world_multiplier }
		multiply_temp_variable = { imp_oil_factor_exp_t = global.mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_world_multiplier }
	}
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { imp_oil_factor_exp_t = 75 }
	divide_temp_variable = { imp_oil_factor_exp_t = 125 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = imp_oil_factor_exp_t min = 0 max = 5 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { imp_oil_factor_t > 1 } }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { imp_oil_factor_t = 1 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { imp_oil_factor_t = 0.2 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { imp_oil_factor_t = 1 }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = imp_oil_factor_t min = 0 max = 2 }
	}
}
# Country scope, called from Imperia's weekly oil update after its own effects.
# Discrete price shocks supplement, rather than replace, the continuous model.
mdcw_cw_update_oil_crisis_tier = {
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tier = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_consumer = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tax = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_output = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_stability = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_ratio value = 6 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tier = 4 }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_consumer = 0.1 }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tax = -0.1 }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_output = -0.1 }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_stability = -0.03 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_ratio value = 4 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tier = 3 }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_consumer = 0.07 }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tax = -0.06 }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_output = -0.06 }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_stability = -0.015 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_ratio value = 2.5 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tier = 2 }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_consumer = 0.04 }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tax = -0.03 }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_output = -0.03 }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_stability = -0.005 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_ratio value = 1.5 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tier = 1 }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_consumer = 0.02 }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tax = -0.01 }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_output = -0.01 }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_stability = 0 }
		}
	}
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_consumer = imp_oil_dependency }
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tax = imp_oil_dependency }
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_output = imp_oil_dependency }
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_stability = imp_oil_dependency }
	add_to_variable = { imp_oil_cost = mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_consumer }
	add_to_variable = { imp_oil_tax = mdcw_cw_oil_crisis_tax }
}


# OPEC proposal: proposer scope, temp mdcw_cw_t_vote_type = 1 raise / 2 cut / 3 restraint.
mdcw_cw_start_opec_vote = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_export_total > 0 } } } imp_calculate_oil_producers = yes }
	mdcw_cw_update_opec_share = yes
	set_global_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_active days = 21 }
	set_global_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_cooldown days = 60 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_vote_type = mdcw_cw_t_vote_type }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_vote_proposer = THIS.id }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_yes_votes = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_no_votes = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_yes_share = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no mdcw_cw_is_opec_member = yes }
		set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_invited days = 21 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev_opec_proposer = global.mdcw_cw_opec_vote_proposer }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_vote_type = 1 } } country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.14 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_vote_type = 2 } } country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.15 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_vote_type = 3 } } country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.16 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { country_exists = USA }
		USA = { country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.17 days = 14 } }
	}
	else = { country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.17 days = 14 } }
}

# Member scope, temp mdcw_cw_t_vote_choice = 1 yes / 2 no / 3 abstain.
mdcw_cw_record_opec_vote = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_active has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_invited NOT = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_responded } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_responded days = 21 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_vote_choice = 1 } }
			set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_yes days = 21 }
			add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_yes_votes = 1 }
			add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_yes_share = mdcw_cw_oil_export_share }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_vote_choice = 2 } }
			add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_no_votes = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Called once by the proposer after the ballot closes. AI members never receive a ballot.
mdcw_cw_finalize_opec_vote = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_active }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_opec_yes_share min = 0 max = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_yes_votes > global.mdcw_cw_opec_no_votes } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_vote_type = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_opec_factor = global.mdcw_cw_opec_yes_share }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_opec_factor = 0.2 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_opec_factor = 1 }
				multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = mdcw_cw_t_opec_factor }
				every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_yes mdcw_cw_is_opec_member = yes }
					set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_opec_price_agreement days = 730 }
					clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_price_cut
				}
			}
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_vote_type = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_opec_factor = global.mdcw_cw_opec_yes_share }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_opec_factor = 0.2 }
				set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_cut_size = mdcw_cw_t_opec_factor }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_opec_factor = 1 }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_opec_factor = global.mdcw_cw_opec_cut_size }
				multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = mdcw_cw_t_opec_factor }
				every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_yes mdcw_cw_is_opec_member = yes }
					set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_opec_price_cut days = 730 }
					clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_price_agreement
				}
			}
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_vote_type = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_opec_factor = global.mdcw_cw_opec_yes_share }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_opec_factor = 0.3 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_opec_factor = 1 }
				multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_level = mdcw_cw_t_opec_factor }
				set_temp_variable = { oil_cost_multiplier_t = global.mdcw_cw_opec_yes_share }
				multiply_temp_variable = { oil_cost_multiplier_t = 0.2 }
				imp_spike_oil_price = yes
				every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_yes mdcw_cw_is_opec_member = yes }
					set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_opec_supply_restraint days = 180 }
				}
			}
			clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_oil_level min = 0.5 max = 12 }
			mdcw_cw_update_opec_share = yes
			mdcw_cw_update_oil_ratio = yes
			imp_update_oil_price_display = yes
			mdcw_cw_update_world_situation = yes
		}
		# Snapshot the named supporters for the news report.
		clr_global_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_last_yes_PER
		clr_global_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_last_yes_IRQ
		clr_global_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_last_yes_KUW
		clr_global_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_last_yes_SAU
		clr_global_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_last_yes_VEN
		clr_global_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_last_yes_QAT
		clr_global_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_last_yes_IND
		clr_global_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_last_yes_LBA
		clr_global_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_last_yes_UAE
		clr_global_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_last_yes_ALG
		if = {
			limit = { PER = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_yes } }
			set_global_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_opec_last_yes_PER days = 60 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { IRQ = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_yes } }
			set_global_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_opec_last_yes_IRQ days = 60 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { KUW = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_yes } }
			set_global_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_opec_last_yes_KUW days = 60 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { SAU = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_yes } }
			set_global_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_opec_last_yes_SAU days = 60 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { VEN = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_yes } }
			set_global_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_opec_last_yes_VEN days = 60 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { QAT = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_yes } }
			set_global_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_opec_last_yes_QAT days = 60 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { IND = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_yes } }
			set_global_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_opec_last_yes_IND days = 60 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { LBA = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_yes } }
			set_global_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_opec_last_yes_LBA days = 60 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { UAE = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_yes } }
			set_global_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_opec_last_yes_UAE days = 60 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { ALG = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_yes } }
			set_global_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_opec_last_yes_ALG days = 60 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev_opec_proposer = global.mdcw_cw_opec_vote_proposer }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_yes_votes > global.mdcw_cw_opec_no_votes } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_vote_type = 1 } } news_event = { id = mdcw_cw.18 } }
				else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_opec_vote_type = 2 } } news_event = { id = mdcw_cw.19 } }
				else = { news_event = { id = mdcw_cw.20 } }
			}
			else = { news_event = { id = mdcw_cw.21 } }
		}
		clr_global_flag = mdcw_cw_opec_vote_active
	}
}

# Country scope. Capacity from MD power rank, bloc-leader tier bonus and modifiers.
mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = {
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_max = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = super_power }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_max = 8 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = great_power }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_max = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = large_power }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_max = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = regional_power }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_max = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = minor_power }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_max = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = non_power }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_max = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = USA
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_max = global.mdcw_cw_tier_bonus_1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = SOV
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_max = global.mdcw_cw_tier_bonus_2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = CHI
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_max = global.mdcw_cw_tier_bonus_3 }
	}
	# National idea International Development Agency and other sources
	add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_max = modifier@mdcw_cw_assistance_capacity }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_free = mdcw_cw_cap_max }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_free = mdcw_cw_cap_used }
}

# Country scope. PP cost to align with each bloc.
mdcw_cw_calculate_switch_costs = {
	# -> Non-Aligned
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_switch_cost_0 = mdcw_cw_bloc_value }
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_switch_cost_0 = 15 }
	clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_switch_cost_0 min = 0 max = 150 }
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_switch_cost_0 = 0.5 }
	round_variable = mdcw_cw_switch_cost_0
	# -> Western Bloc
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_switch_cost_1 = mdcw_cw_bloc_value }
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_switch_cost_1 = 15 }
