	clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_switch_cost_1 min = 0 max = 150 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
		multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_switch_cost_1 = 0.5 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_disc = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = USA
			NOT = { original_tag = USA }
			USA = { mdcw_cw_has_active_program_to_prev = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_disc = 0.25 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = USA
			NOT = { original_tag = USA }
			USA = {
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_party@PREV > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_pps_access@THIS = 2 }
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_disc = 0.5 }
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_disc min = 0 max = 0.5 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_mult = 1 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_mult = mdcw_cw_t_disc }
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_switch_cost_1 = mdcw_cw_t_mult }
	round_variable = mdcw_cw_switch_cost_1
	# -> Soviet Bloc
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_switch_cost_2 = mdcw_cw_bloc_value }
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_switch_cost_2 = 15 }
	clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_switch_cost_2 min = 0 max = 150 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
		multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_switch_cost_2 = 0.5 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_disc = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = SOV
			NOT = { original_tag = SOV }
			SOV = { mdcw_cw_has_active_program_to_prev = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_disc = 0.25 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = SOV
			NOT = { original_tag = SOV }
			SOV = {
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_party@PREV > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_pps_access@THIS = 2 }
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_disc = 0.5 }
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_disc min = 0 max = 0.5 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_mult = 1 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_mult = mdcw_cw_t_disc }
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_switch_cost_2 = mdcw_cw_t_mult }
	round_variable = mdcw_cw_switch_cost_2
	# -> Beijing Camp
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_switch_cost_3 = mdcw_cw_bloc_value }
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_switch_cost_3 = 15 }
	clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_switch_cost_3 min = 0 max = 150 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
		multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_switch_cost_3 = 0.5 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_disc = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = CHI
			NOT = { original_tag = CHI }
			CHI = { mdcw_cw_has_active_program_to_prev = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_disc = 0.25 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = CHI
			NOT = { original_tag = CHI }
			CHI = {
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_party@PREV > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_pps_access@THIS = 2 }
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_disc = 0.5 }
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_disc min = 0 max = 0.5 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_mult = 1 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_mult = mdcw_cw_t_disc }
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_switch_cost_3 = mdcw_cw_t_mult }
	round_variable = mdcw_cw_switch_cost_3
}

# Country scope. Rebuilds every programme-derived value of this country.
# Never uses ROOT: inside each loop THIS = partner, PREV = this country.
mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = {
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_construction = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_construction = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_research = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_research = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_eff_growth = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_eff_growth = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_eff_max = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_eff_max = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_productivity = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_productivity = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_consumer = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_consumer = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_training = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_training = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_army_xp = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_army_xp = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_mil_output = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_mil_output = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_pp = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_pp = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_bureaucracy = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_bureaucracy = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_used = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_cost_monthly = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_mil_prog_out = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_pp_gain = 0 }
	# Cost factor of our military programmes (national idea Military Advisers Abroad)
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_mpc = 1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_mpc = modifier@mdcw_cw_military_programme_cost }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_mpc min = 0 }
	# Outgoing programmes (this country is the donor)
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = mdcw_cw_out
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost_factor = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { mdcw_cw_opposing_to_prev = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost_factor = 1.5 }
		}
		# Construction Assistance
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p1_size@THIS > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_size = PREV.mdcw_cw_p1_size@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_t_size }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = 0.5 }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_used = mdcw_cw_t_size } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = 0.4 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = mdcw_cw_t_cost_factor }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p1_state@THIS = 2 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = 0.5 }
			}
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cost_monthly = mdcw_cw_t_cost } }
			set_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p1_left@THIS = PREV.mdcw_cw_p1_end@THIS }
			subtract_from_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p1_left@THIS = global.num_days }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p1_state@THIS = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = -0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_construction = mdcw_cw_t_val } }
			}
		}
		# Technical Mission
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p2_size@THIS > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_size = PREV.mdcw_cw_p2_size@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_t_size }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = 0.5 }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_used = mdcw_cw_t_size } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = 0.3 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = mdcw_cw_t_cost_factor }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p2_state@THIS = 2 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = 0.5 }
			}
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cost_monthly = mdcw_cw_t_cost } }
			set_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p2_left@THIS = PREV.mdcw_cw_p2_end@THIS }
			subtract_from_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p2_left@THIS = global.num_days }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p2_state@THIS = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = -0.02 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_research = mdcw_cw_t_val } }
			}
		}
		# Industrial Equipment Program
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p3_size@THIS > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_size = PREV.mdcw_cw_p3_size@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_t_size }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = 0.5 }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_used = mdcw_cw_t_size } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = 0.5 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = mdcw_cw_t_cost_factor }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p3_state@THIS = 2 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = 0.5 }
			}
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cost_monthly = mdcw_cw_t_cost } }
			set_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p3_left@THIS = PREV.mdcw_cw_p3_end@THIS }
			subtract_from_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p3_left@THIS = global.num_days }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p3_state@THIS = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = -0.02 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_mil_output = mdcw_cw_t_val } }
			}
		}
		# Productivity Mission
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p4_size@THIS > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_size = PREV.mdcw_cw_p4_size@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_t_size }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = 0.5 }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_used = mdcw_cw_t_size } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = 0.3 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = mdcw_cw_t_cost_factor }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p4_state@THIS = 2 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = 0.5 }
			}
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cost_monthly = mdcw_cw_t_cost } }
			set_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p4_left@THIS = PREV.mdcw_cw_p4_end@THIS }
			subtract_from_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p4_left@THIS = global.num_days }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p4_state@THIS = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = -0.005 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_productivity = mdcw_cw_t_val } }
			}
		}
		# Consumer Supply Credits
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p5_size@THIS > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_size = PREV.mdcw_cw_p5_size@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_t_size }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = 0.5 }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_used = mdcw_cw_t_size } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = 0.6 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = mdcw_cw_t_cost_factor }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p5_state@THIS = 2 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = 0.5 }
			}
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cost_monthly = mdcw_cw_t_cost } }
			set_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p5_left@THIS = PREV.mdcw_cw_p5_end@THIS }
			subtract_from_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p5_left@THIS = global.num_days }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p5_state@THIS = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = 0.01 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_consumer = mdcw_cw_t_val } }
			}
		}
		# Military Training Mission
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p6_size@THIS > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_size = PREV.mdcw_cw_p6_size@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_t_size }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = 0.5 }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_used = mdcw_cw_t_size } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = 0.3 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = mdcw_cw_t_cost_factor }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = mdcw_cw_t_mpc }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p6_state@THIS = 2 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = 0.5 }
			}
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cost_monthly = mdcw_cw_t_cost } }
			set_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p6_left@THIS = PREV.mdcw_cw_p6_end@THIS }
			subtract_from_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p6_left@THIS = global.num_days }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p6_state@THIS = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = -0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_army_xp = mdcw_cw_t_val } }
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_mil_prog_out = 1 } }
			}
		}
		# Arms Production Assistance
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p7_size@THIS > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_size = PREV.mdcw_cw_p7_size@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_t_size }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = 0.5 }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_used = mdcw_cw_t_size } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = 0.4 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = mdcw_cw_t_cost_factor }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = mdcw_cw_t_mpc }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p7_state@THIS = 2 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = 0.5 }
			}
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cost_monthly = mdcw_cw_t_cost } }
			set_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p7_left@THIS = PREV.mdcw_cw_p7_end@THIS }
			subtract_from_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p7_left@THIS = global.num_days }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p7_state@THIS = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = -0.02 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_mil_output = mdcw_cw_t_val } }
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_mil_prog_out = 1 } }
			}
		}
		# Administrative Assistance
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p8_size@THIS > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_size = PREV.mdcw_cw_p8_size@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_t_size }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = 0.5 }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_used = mdcw_cw_t_size } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = 0.2 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = mdcw_cw_t_cost_factor }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p8_state@THIS = 2 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = 0.5 }
			}
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cost_monthly = mdcw_cw_t_cost } }
			set_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p8_left@THIS = PREV.mdcw_cw_p8_end@THIS }
			subtract_from_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p8_left@THIS = global.num_days }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p8_state@THIS = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = -0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_g_pp = mdcw_cw_t_val } }
			}
		}
		# Public Political Support
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_pps_party@THIS > 0 } }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_used = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cost = 0.2 }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_cost_monthly = mdcw_cw_t_cost } }
			set_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_pps_left@THIS = PREV.mdcw_cw_pps_end@THIS }
			subtract_from_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_pps_left@THIS = global.num_days }
		}
	}
	# Great Power Competition: running programmes from two different blocs
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_seen_1 = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_seen_2 = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_seen_3 = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = mdcw_cw_in
		if = {
			limit = { mdcw_cw_has_active_program_to_prev = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_seen_1 = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_seen_2 = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_seen_3 = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_seen = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_seen = mdcw_cw_t_seen_1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_seen = mdcw_cw_t_seen_2 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_seen = mdcw_cw_t_seen_3 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_seen > 1 } }
		set_country_flag = mdcw_cw_gpc
	}
	else = { clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_gpc }
	# Incoming programmes (this country is the receiver)
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = mdcw_cw_in
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_eff = 1 }
		PREV = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = imp_eco_3_dynamic_modifier } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_eff = 1.25 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = imp_eco_2_dynamic_modifier } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_eff = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = imp_eco_1_dynamic_modifier } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_eff = 0.6 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_mod = 1 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_mod = modifier@mdcw_cw_assistance_effectiveness }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_eff = mdcw_cw_t_mod }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_gpc }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_eff = 1.1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { mdcw_cw_same_bloc_as_prev = yes }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_eff = 1.25 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_eff = global.mdcw_cw_tier_factor_1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_eff = global.mdcw_cw_tier_factor_2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_eff = global.mdcw_cw_tier_factor_3 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { mdcw_cw_opposing_to_prev = yes }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_eff = 0.75 }
		}
		# Construction Assistance
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_state@PREV = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_p1_size@PREV }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = 0.5 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_t_eff }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = 0.08 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_construction = mdcw_cw_t_val } }
		}
		# Technical Mission
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_state@PREV = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_p2_size@PREV }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = 0.5 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_t_eff }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = 0.06 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_research = mdcw_cw_t_val } }
		}
		# Industrial Equipment Program
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_state@PREV = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_p3_size@PREV }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = 0.5 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_t_eff }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = 0.1 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_eff_growth = mdcw_cw_t_val } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = 0.03 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_eff_max = mdcw_cw_t_val } }
		}
		# Productivity Mission
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p4_state@PREV = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_p4_size@PREV }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = 0.5 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_t_eff }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = 0.03 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_productivity = mdcw_cw_t_val } }
		}
		# Consumer Supply Credits
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p5_state@PREV = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_p5_size@PREV }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = 0.5 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_t_eff }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = -0.03 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_consumer = mdcw_cw_t_val } }
		}
		# Military Training Mission
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p6_state@PREV = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_p6_size@PREV }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = 0.5 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_t_eff }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = -0.1 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_training = mdcw_cw_t_val } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = 0.05 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_army_xp = mdcw_cw_t_val } }
		}
		# Arms Production Assistance
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p7_state@PREV = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_p7_size@PREV }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = 0.5 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_t_eff }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = 0.06 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_mil_output = mdcw_cw_t_val } }
		}
		# Administrative Assistance
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p8_state@PREV = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_p8_size@PREV }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = 0.5 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sf = mdcw_cw_t_eff }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = 0.05 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_pp = mdcw_cw_t_val } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = -0.03 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_val = mdcw_cw_t_sf }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_bureaucracy = mdcw_cw_t_val } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_party@PREV > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_pps_access@THIS = 3 }
			}
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_pp_gain = -0.02 } }
		}
	}
	# Receiver caps, then net = received + given
	# Receiving limits, raised by mdcw_cw_assistance_limit (national idea Open Door Aid Policy)
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_capf = 1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_capf = modifier@mdcw_cw_assistance_limit }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_capf min = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = 0.2 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = mdcw_cw_t_capf }
	clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_r_construction min = 0 max = mdcw_cw_t_cap }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_construction = mdcw_cw_r_construction }
	add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_construction = mdcw_cw_g_construction }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = 0.15 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = mdcw_cw_t_capf }
	clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_r_research min = 0 max = mdcw_cw_t_cap }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_research = mdcw_cw_r_research }
	add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_research = mdcw_cw_g_research }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = 0.25 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = mdcw_cw_t_capf }
	clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_r_eff_growth min = 0 max = mdcw_cw_t_cap }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_eff_growth = mdcw_cw_r_eff_growth }
	add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_eff_growth = mdcw_cw_g_eff_growth }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = 0.08 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = mdcw_cw_t_capf }
	clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_r_eff_max min = 0 max = mdcw_cw_t_cap }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_eff_max = mdcw_cw_r_eff_max }
	add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_eff_max = mdcw_cw_g_eff_max }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = 0.06 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = mdcw_cw_t_capf }
	clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_r_productivity min = 0 max = mdcw_cw_t_cap }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_productivity = mdcw_cw_r_productivity }
	add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_productivity = mdcw_cw_g_productivity }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = -0.08 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = mdcw_cw_t_capf }
	clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_r_consumer min = mdcw_cw_t_cap max = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_consumer = mdcw_cw_r_consumer }
	add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_consumer = mdcw_cw_g_consumer }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = -0.25 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = mdcw_cw_t_capf }
	clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_r_training min = mdcw_cw_t_cap max = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_training = mdcw_cw_r_training }
	add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_training = mdcw_cw_g_training }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = 0.15 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = mdcw_cw_t_capf }
	clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_r_army_xp min = 0 max = mdcw_cw_t_cap }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_army_xp = mdcw_cw_r_army_xp }
	add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_army_xp = mdcw_cw_g_army_xp }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = 0.15 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = mdcw_cw_t_capf }
	clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_r_mil_output min = 0 max = mdcw_cw_t_cap }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_mil_output = mdcw_cw_r_mil_output }
	add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_mil_output = mdcw_cw_g_mil_output }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = 0.15 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = mdcw_cw_t_capf }
	clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_r_pp min = 0 max = mdcw_cw_t_cap }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_pp = mdcw_cw_r_pp }
	add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_pp = mdcw_cw_g_pp }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = -0.1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_cap = mdcw_cw_t_capf }
	clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_r_bureaucracy min = mdcw_cw_t_cap max = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_bureaucracy = mdcw_cw_r_bureaucracy }
	add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_bureaucracy = mdcw_cw_g_bureaucracy }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_out = mdcw_cw_out^num }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_n_in = mdcw_cw_in^num }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_cost_weekly = mdcw_cw_cost_monthly }
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_cost_weekly = 12 }
	divide_variable = { mdcw_cw_cost_weekly = 52 }
	mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
	mdcw_cw_calculate_switch_costs = yes
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

# Sender scope, PREV = target.
mdcw_cw_link_add = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { mdcw_cw_out = PREV.id } } }
		add_to_array = { mdcw_cw_out = PREV.id }
	}
	PREV = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { mdcw_cw_in = PREV.id } } }
			add_to_array = { mdcw_cw_in = PREV.id }
		}
	}
}

# Sender scope, PREV = target.
mdcw_cw_link_remove_if_empty = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { mdcw_cw_has_link_with_prev = yes } }
		remove_from_array = { mdcw_cw_out = PREV.id }
		PREV = { remove_from_array = { mdcw_cw_in = PREV.id } }
	}
}

# Sender scope, PREV = target. Refresh both sides after any change.
mdcw_cw_refresh_pair = {
	mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes
	PREV = { mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes }
	mdcw_cw_touch_gui = yes
}

### Construction Assistance ###
# Sender scope, PREV = target. temp mdcw_cw_t_size (1-3).
mdcw_cw_start_program_1 = {
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_size@PREV = mdcw_cw_t_size }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_state@PREV = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_end@PREV = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_end@PREV = 365 }
	mdcw_cw_link_add = yes
	add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_program_partner }
	reverse_add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_program_partner }
	if = {
		limit = { mdcw_cw_opposing_to_prev = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 0.5 }
		mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
	}
	mdcw_cw_refresh_pair = yes
}
# Sender scope, PREV = target. temp mdcw_cw_t_by_receiver = 1 when the receiver ends it.
mdcw_cw_end_program_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_size@PREV > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_by_receiver = 1 } }
			# The receiver ended it: tell the donor (this scope).
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_ev2_today } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_ev2_today days = 1 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev2_partner = PREV.id }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev2_prog = 1 }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev2_more = 0 }
				country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.2 }
			}
			else = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev2_more = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			# The donor ended it or it expired: tell the receiver.
			PREV = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_ev6_today } }
						set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_ev6_today days = 1 value = 1 }
						set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev6_partner = PREV.id }
						set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev6_prog = 1 }
						set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev6_more = 0 }
						country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.6 }
					}
					else = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev6_more = 1 } }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_size@PREV = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_state@PREV = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_end@PREV = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_left@PREV = 0 }
		mdcw_cw_link_remove_if_empty = yes
		mdcw_cw_refresh_pair = yes
	}
}
# Sender scope, PREV = target. Suspend <-> resume.
mdcw_cw_toggle_program_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_state@PREV = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_state@PREV = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_state@PREV = 2 }
			NOT = { has_war_with = PREV }
		}
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_state@PREV = 1 }
	}
	mdcw_cw_refresh_pair = yes
}

### Technical Mission ###
# Sender scope, PREV = target. temp mdcw_cw_t_size (1-3).
mdcw_cw_start_program_2 = {
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_size@PREV = mdcw_cw_t_size }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_state@PREV = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_end@PREV = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_end@PREV = 365 }
	mdcw_cw_link_add = yes
	add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_program_partner }
	reverse_add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_program_partner }
	if = {
		limit = { mdcw_cw_opposing_to_prev = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 0.5 }
		mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
	}
	mdcw_cw_refresh_pair = yes
}
# Sender scope, PREV = target. temp mdcw_cw_t_by_receiver = 1 when the receiver ends it.
mdcw_cw_end_program_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_size@PREV > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_by_receiver = 1 } }
			# The receiver ended it: tell the donor (this scope).
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_ev2_today } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_ev2_today days = 1 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev2_partner = PREV.id }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev2_prog = 2 }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev2_more = 0 }
				country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.2 }
			}
			else = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev2_more = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			# The donor ended it or it expired: tell the receiver.
			PREV = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_ev6_today } }
						set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_ev6_today days = 1 value = 1 }
						set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev6_partner = PREV.id }
						set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev6_prog = 2 }
						set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev6_more = 0 }
						country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.6 }
					}
					else = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev6_more = 1 } }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_size@PREV = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_state@PREV = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_end@PREV = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_left@PREV = 0 }
		mdcw_cw_link_remove_if_empty = yes
		mdcw_cw_refresh_pair = yes
	}
}
# Sender scope, PREV = target. Suspend <-> resume.
mdcw_cw_toggle_program_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_state@PREV = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_state@PREV = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_state@PREV = 2 }
			NOT = { has_war_with = PREV }
		}
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_state@PREV = 1 }
	}
	mdcw_cw_refresh_pair = yes
}

### Industrial Equipment Program ###
# Sender scope, PREV = target. temp mdcw_cw_t_size (1-3).
mdcw_cw_start_program_3 = {
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_size@PREV = mdcw_cw_t_size }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_state@PREV = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_end@PREV = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_end@PREV = 365 }
	mdcw_cw_link_add = yes
	add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_program_partner }
	reverse_add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_program_partner }
	if = {
		limit = { mdcw_cw_opposing_to_prev = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 0.5 }
		mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
	}
	mdcw_cw_refresh_pair = yes
}
# Sender scope, PREV = target. temp mdcw_cw_t_by_receiver = 1 when the receiver ends it.
mdcw_cw_end_program_3 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_size@PREV > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_by_receiver = 1 } }
			# The receiver ended it: tell the donor (this scope).
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_ev2_today } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_ev2_today days = 1 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev2_partner = PREV.id }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev2_prog = 3 }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev2_more = 0 }
				country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.2 }
			}
			else = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev2_more = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			# The donor ended it or it expired: tell the receiver.
			PREV = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_ev6_today } }
						set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_ev6_today days = 1 value = 1 }
						set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev6_partner = PREV.id }
						set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev6_prog = 3 }
						set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev6_more = 0 }
						country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.6 }
					}
					else = { add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev6_more = 1 } }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_size@PREV = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_state@PREV = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_end@PREV = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_left@PREV = 0 }
		mdcw_cw_link_remove_if_empty = yes
		mdcw_cw_refresh_pair = yes
	}
}
# Sender scope, PREV = target. Suspend <-> resume.
mdcw_cw_toggle_program_3 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_state@PREV = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_state@PREV = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_state@PREV = 2 }
			NOT = { has_war_with = PREV }
		}
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_state@PREV = 1 }
	}
	mdcw_cw_refresh_pair = yes
}
