# Sender scope, PREV = target. Called when the target accepts the diplomatic action.
mdcw_cw_clear_pending_offer = {
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_pend_type@PREV = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_pend_size@PREV = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_pend_until@PREV = 0 }
	mdcw_cw_touch_gui = yes
}

# Sender scope, PREV = recipient. Validate, start, clear the pair and report the outcome.
mdcw_cw_start_pending_program = {
	mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fail = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_size = mdcw_cw_pend_size@PREV }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_free < mdcw_cw_t_size }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_size < 1 }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_size > 3 }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pend_type@PREV < 1 }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pend_type@PREV > 8 }
				has_war_with = PREV
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fail = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pend_type@PREV = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_size@PREV > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fail = 1 }
			}
			else = { mdcw_cw_start_program_1 = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pend_type@PREV = 2 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_size@PREV > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fail = 1 }
			}
			else = { mdcw_cw_start_program_2 = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pend_type@PREV = 3 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_size@PREV > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fail = 1 }
			}
			else = { mdcw_cw_start_program_3 = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pend_type@PREV = 4 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p4_size@PREV > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fail = 1 }
			}
			else = { mdcw_cw_start_program_4 = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pend_type@PREV = 5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p5_size@PREV > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fail = 1 }
			}
			else = { mdcw_cw_start_program_5 = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pend_type@PREV = 6 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p6_size@PREV > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fail = 1 }
			}
			else = { mdcw_cw_start_program_6 = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pend_type@PREV = 7 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p7_size@PREV > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fail = 1 }
			}
			else = { mdcw_cw_start_program_7 = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pend_type@PREV = 8 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p8_size@PREV > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fail = 1 }
			}
			else = { mdcw_cw_start_program_8 = yes }
		}
		else = { set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fail = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fail = 1 } }
		add_political_power = 25
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev9_partner = PREV.id }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev9_prog = mdcw_cw_pend_type@PREV }
	}
	mdcw_cw_clear_pending_offer = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fail = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.9 }
	}
	else = { country_event = { id = mdcw_cw_assistance_reply.1 } }
}

# Sender scope, PREV = target. Suspend every running programme (war between the two).
mdcw_cw_suspend_links_with_prev = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_state@PREV = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_state@PREV = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_state@PREV = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_state@PREV = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_state@PREV = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_state@PREV = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p4_state@PREV = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p4_state@PREV = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p5_state@PREV = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p5_state@PREV = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p6_state@PREV = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p6_state@PREV = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p7_state@PREV = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p7_state@PREV = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p8_state@PREV = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_p8_state@PREV = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { mdcw_cw_has_link_with_prev = yes }
		mdcw_cw_refresh_pair = yes
	}
}

# Sender scope, PREV = target. Ends expired programmes and links where either side no longer exists.
mdcw_cw_expire_links_with_prev = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_size@PREV > 0 }
			OR = {
				exists = no
				PREV = { exists = no }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p1_end@PREV < global.num_days }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_by_receiver = 0 }
		mdcw_cw_end_program_1 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_size@PREV > 0 }
			OR = {
				exists = no
				PREV = { exists = no }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p2_end@PREV < global.num_days }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_by_receiver = 0 }
		mdcw_cw_end_program_2 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_size@PREV > 0 }
			OR = {
				exists = no
				PREV = { exists = no }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p3_end@PREV < global.num_days }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_by_receiver = 0 }
		mdcw_cw_end_program_3 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p4_size@PREV > 0 }
			OR = {
				exists = no
				PREV = { exists = no }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p4_end@PREV < global.num_days }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_by_receiver = 0 }
		mdcw_cw_end_program_4 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p5_size@PREV > 0 }
			OR = {
				exists = no
				PREV = { exists = no }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p5_end@PREV < global.num_days }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_by_receiver = 0 }
		mdcw_cw_end_program_5 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p6_size@PREV > 0 }
			OR = {
				exists = no
				PREV = { exists = no }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p6_end@PREV < global.num_days }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_by_receiver = 0 }
		mdcw_cw_end_program_6 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p7_size@PREV > 0 }
			OR = {
				exists = no
				PREV = { exists = no }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p7_end@PREV < global.num_days }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_by_receiver = 0 }
		mdcw_cw_end_program_7 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p8_size@PREV > 0 }
			OR = {
				exists = no
				PREV = { exists = no }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p8_end@PREV < global.num_days }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_by_receiver = 0 }
		mdcw_cw_end_program_8 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_party@PREV > 0 }
			OR = {
				exists = no
				PREV = { exists = no }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_end@PREV < global.num_days }
			}
		}
		mdcw_cw_end_pps = yes
	}
}

### Public Political Support ###
# Sponsor scope, PREV = target. Party index comes from mdcw_cw_send_party (0-23).
mdcw_cw_start_pps = {
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_party@PREV = mdcw_cw_send_party }
	add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_party@PREV = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_end@PREV = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_end@PREV = 365 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_cd@PREV = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_cd@PREV = 730 }
	PREV = { set_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_access@PREV = 0 } }
	mdcw_cw_link_add = yes
	if = {
		limit = { mdcw_cw_opposing_to_prev = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { PREV = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_bloc_value > 5 } } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 1 }
			mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 0.5 }
			mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				PREV = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
				country_exists = USA
			}
			USA = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_foreign_interference } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				PREV = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
				country_exists = SOV
			}
			SOV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_foreign_interference } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				PREV = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 } }
				country_exists = CHI
			}
			CHI = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_foreign_interference } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { PREV = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 0.1 }
		mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = mdcw_ni_broadcasting }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 0.1 }
		mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
	}
	PREV = {
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev4_partner = PREV.id }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev4_party = PREV.mdcw_cw_send_party }
		country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.4 }
	}
	mdcw_cw_refresh_pair = yes
}
# Sponsor scope, PREV = target.
mdcw_cw_end_pps = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_party@PREV > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_party = mdcw_cw_pps_party@PREV }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_party = 1 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_party@PREV = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_end@PREV = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_left@PREV = 0 }
		PREV = { set_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_access@PREV = 0 } }
		mdcw_cw_link_remove_if_empty = yes
		mdcw_cw_refresh_pair = yes
	}
}
# Receiver scope, PREV = sponsor. temp mdcw_cw_t_access (0 external, 1 permit, 2 facilitate, 3 restrict).
mdcw_cw_set_pps_access = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_access = 3 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_access@PREV = 3 } }
		}
		add_political_power = -25
	}
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_access@PREV = mdcw_cw_t_access }
	PREV = {
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev5_partner = PREV.id }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev5_access = mdcw_cw_t_access }
		country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.5 }
	}
	mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes
	mdcw_cw_calculate_switch_costs = yes
	mdcw_cw_touch_gui = yes
}
# Receiver scope. Applies this month's popularity from every foreign campaign.
mdcw_cw_apply_pps = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_pps_total = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_res = 1 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_res = modifier@mdcw_cw_ideological_defence }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_res min = 0 max = 1 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = mdcw_cw_in
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_party@PREV > 0 }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_end@PREV > global.num_days }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_amount = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_pps_access@THIS = 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_amount = 0.000250 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_pps_access@THIS = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_amount = 0.000625 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_pps_access@THIS = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_amount = 0.001250 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_pps_access@THIS = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_amount = 0.000125 }
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_amount = mdcw_cw_t_res }
			# Sponsor's broadcasting (THIS = sponsor)
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sup = 1 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sup = modifier@mdcw_cw_support_effectiveness }
			multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_amount = mdcw_cw_t_sup }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_room = 0.002 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_room = mdcw_cw_t_pps_total }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_amount min = 0 max = mdcw_cw_t_room }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_amount > 0 } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_pps_total = mdcw_cw_t_amount }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_party = mdcw_cw_pps_party@PREV }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_party = 1 }
				PREV = {
					set_temp_variable = { party_index = mdcw_cw_t_party }
					set_temp_variable = { party_popularity_increase = mdcw_cw_t_amount }
					set_temp_variable = { temp_outlook_increase = mdcw_cw_t_amount }
					change_relative_party_popularity = yes
					set_temp_variable = { temp_outlook_increase = 0 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

### Alignment ###
# Country scope (the aligning country). temp mdcw_cw_new_alignment (0-3).
# temp mdcw_cw_t_free = 1: no political power cost and no alignment lock (estranged drift).
mdcw_cw_change_alignment = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_old = mdcw_cw_alignment }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_pp = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_free = 1 } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_new_alignment = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_pp = mdcw_cw_switch_cost_0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_new_alignment = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_pp = mdcw_cw_switch_cost_1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_new_alignment = 2 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_pp = mdcw_cw_switch_cost_2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_new_alignment = 3 } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_pp = mdcw_cw_switch_cost_3 }
		}
	}
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_pp = -1 }
	add_political_power = mdcw_cw_t_pp
	clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_estranged
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_estranged_left = 0 }
	# Leaving a bloc hurts; entering from Non-Aligned does not.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_old > 0 } }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = mdcw_cw_diplomatic_realignment days = 180 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_old = 1 }
				country_exists = USA
			}
			USA = {
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_defection }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev3_partner = PREV.id }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev3_old = mdcw_cw_t_old }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev3_new = mdcw_cw_new_alignment }
				country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.3 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_old = 2 }
				country_exists = SOV
			}
			SOV = {
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_defection }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev3_partner = PREV.id }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev3_old = mdcw_cw_t_old }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev3_new = mdcw_cw_new_alignment }
				country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.3 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_old = 3 }
				country_exists = CHI
			}
			CHI = {
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_defection }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev3_partner = PREV.id }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev3_old = mdcw_cw_t_old }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev3_new = mdcw_cw_new_alignment }
				country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.3 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = mdcw_cw_bloc_value }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_old = 0 } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 0.1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_new_alignment = 0 } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 0.05 }
	}
	else = { multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 0.2 } }
	mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = mdcw_cw_new_alignment }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_free = 1 } } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_alignment_locked days = 730 value = 1 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_lock_until = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_lock_until = 730 }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_lock_left = 730 }
	}
	else = {
		clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_alignment_locked
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_lock_left = 0 }
	}
	# Subjects follow their overlord.
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
			is_subject_of = PREV
		}
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = PREV.mdcw_cw_alignment }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 }
			country_exists = USA
			NOT = { original_tag = USA }
		}
		USA = {
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev3_partner = PREV.id }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev3_old = mdcw_cw_t_old }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev3_new = mdcw_cw_new_alignment }
			country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.3 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 }
			country_exists = SOV
			NOT = { original_tag = SOV }
		}
		SOV = {
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev3_partner = PREV.id }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev3_old = mdcw_cw_t_old }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev3_new = mdcw_cw_new_alignment }
			country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.3 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 }
			country_exists = CHI
			NOT = { original_tag = CHI }
		}
		CHI = {
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev3_partner = PREV.id }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev3_old = mdcw_cw_t_old }
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev3_new = mdcw_cw_new_alignment }
			country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.3 }
		}
	}
	mdcw_cw_rebuild_blocs = yes
	mdcw_cw_refresh_all_bloc_effects = yes
	mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = mdcw_cw_out
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = mdcw_cw_in
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = USA }
		USA = { mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = SOV }
		SOV = { mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = CHI }
		CHI = { mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes }
	}
	mdcw_cw_touch_gui = yes
}

# Country scope, monthly. A member whose ruling party no longer fits its bloc becomes estranged;
# after 365 days it drifts to Non-Aligned. A fitting government ends the estrangement.
mdcw_cw_update_estrangement = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 }
			NOT = { mdcw_cw_fits_own_bloc = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_estranged } }
			set_country_flag = mdcw_cw_estranged
			set_variable = { mdcw_cw_estranged_until = global.num_days }
			add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_estranged_until = 365 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_estranged_until < global.num_days } }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_new_alignment = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_free = 1 }
			mdcw_cw_change_alignment = yes
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_free = 0 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_estranged }
		clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_estranged
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_estranged_left = 0 }
	}
}
### Monthly ###
# Global, once per month.
mdcw_cw_global_monthly = {
	# Blocs and sanctions first: they set the tension baseline.
	mdcw_cw_rebuild_blocs = yes
	# Tension drifts back to its baseline (40 plus sanctions between the blocs).
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension > 60 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = -2 }
		mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension > global.mdcw_cw_tension_baseline } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = -1 }
		mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension < global.mdcw_cw_tension_baseline_low } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 0.5 }
		mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
	}
	# Oil: OPEC price level, consumer prices, embargo
	mdcw_cw_update_oil_level = yes
	# One-time save migration: apply the trade modifier to oil embargoes already active.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_oil_trade_penalty_migrated } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_out > 0 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_targets
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_oil_trade_embargo }
					PREV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = mdcw_cw_oil_trade_embargo } }
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = mdcw_cw_oil_trade_penalty_migrated
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_oil_embargo_in > 0 } }
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_oil_embargo_pressure = yes
	}
	mdcw_cw_recalculate_oil_embargo_world = yes
	mdcw_cw_update_world_situation = yes
	mdcw_cw_update_programme_days = yes
	mdcw_cw_touch_gui = yes
}
# Country scope, every month.
mdcw_cw_country_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } }
		mdcw_cw_setup_country = yes
	}
	# Subjects follow their overlord's bloc.
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_subject = yes
			overlord = {
				has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
				NOT = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = PREV.mdcw_cw_alignment } }
			}
		}
		overlord = { set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_al = mdcw_cw_alignment } }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = mdcw_cw_t_al }
	}
	# Ideology: does our government still fit our bloc?
	mdcw_cw_update_estrangement = yes
	# Outgoing: collect expired links first, then end them (never edit an array while looping it).
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_out^num > 0 } }
		clear_temp_array = mdcw_cw_t_expire
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = mdcw_cw_out
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						exists = no
						AND = {
							check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p1_size@THIS > 0 }
							check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p1_end@THIS < global.num_days }
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p2_size@THIS > 0 }
							check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p2_end@THIS < global.num_days }
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p3_size@THIS > 0 }
							check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p3_end@THIS < global.num_days }
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p4_size@THIS > 0 }
							check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p4_end@THIS < global.num_days }
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p5_size@THIS > 0 }
							check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p5_end@THIS < global.num_days }
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p6_size@THIS > 0 }
							check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p6_end@THIS < global.num_days }
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p7_size@THIS > 0 }
							check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p7_end@THIS < global.num_days }
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p8_size@THIS > 0 }
							check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p8_end@THIS < global.num_days }
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_pps_party@THIS > 0 }
							check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_pps_end@THIS < global.num_days }
						}
					}
				}
				add_to_temp_array = { mdcw_cw_t_expire = THIS.id }
			}
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = mdcw_cw_t_expire
			PREV = { mdcw_cw_expire_links_with_prev = yes }
		}
	}
	# Incoming: drop links to donors that no longer exist.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_in^num > 0 } }
		clear_temp_array = mdcw_cw_t_dead
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = mdcw_cw_in
			if = {
				limit = { exists = no }
				add_to_temp_array = { mdcw_cw_t_dead = THIS.id }
			}
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = mdcw_cw_t_dead
			PREV = { PREV = { mdcw_cw_expire_links_with_prev = yes } }
		}
	}
	# Programme and campaign costs enter MD's weekly budget calculation.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_in^num > 0 } }
		mdcw_cw_apply_pps = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_out^num > 0 }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_in^num > 0 }
				has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_gpc
			}
		}
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes
	}
	else = {
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
		mdcw_cw_calculate_switch_costs = yes
	}
	mdcw_cw_update_bloc_effects = yes
	# Bloc upkeep enters MD's weekly budget calculation.
	mdcw_cw_update_world_market = yes
}

# Country scope. Preserve the original annual cost while MD books expenses weekly.
mdcw_cw_add_weekly_expenses = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_monthly = mdcw_cw_cost_monthly }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_monthly = mdcw_cw_bloc_upkeep }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = mdcw_ni_broadcasting }
		add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_monthly = 0.2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = mdcw_ni_petroleum_reserve }
		add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_monthly = 0.1 }
	}
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_monthly = 12 }
	divide_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_monthly = 52 }
	add_to_variable = { additional_expenses_rate = mdcw_cw_t_monthly }
}

# Global. Counts wars between blocs and derives Market Confidence and Arms Demand.
mdcw_cw_update_world_situation = {
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bloc_wars = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_war = yes
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 }
			any_enemy_country = {
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = PREV.mdcw_cw_alignment } }
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bloc_wars = 0.5 }
	}
	# Components of Market Confidence (shown in the tooltip)
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_mc_tension = global.mdcw_cw_tension }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_mc_tension = 0.7 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_mc_wars = global.mdcw_cw_bloc_wars }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_mc_wars = 3 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_mc_frag = global.mdcw_cw_x_econ }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_mc_frag = 0.15 }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_mc_frag min = 0 max = 10 }
	# Oil shock: real oil price ratio to January 1970 (market price x OPEC level)
	mdcw_cw_update_oil_ratio = yes
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_mc_oil = global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_mc_oil = 1.2 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_mc_oil = 12 }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_mc_oil min = 0 max = 30 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_market = 100 }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_market = global.mdcw_cw_mc_tension }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_market = global.mdcw_cw_mc_wars }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_market = global.mdcw_cw_mc_frag }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_market = global.mdcw_cw_mc_oil }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_market min = 5 max = 100 }
	round_variable = global.mdcw_cw_market
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_arms = global.mdcw_cw_tension }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_arms = 0.8 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_m = global.mdcw_cw_bloc_wars }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_m = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_arms = mdcw_cw_t_m }
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_m = global.mdcw_cw_mil_programs }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_m = 0.2 }
	add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_arms = mdcw_cw_t_m }
	# Petrodollars: oil exporters spend their windfall on weapons
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_arms_petro = global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_arms_petro = 1.5 }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_arms_petro = 2 }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_arms_petro min = 0 max = 10 }
	add_to_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_arms = global.mdcw_cw_arms_petro }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_arms min = 0 max = 100 }
	round_variable = global.mdcw_cw_arms
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_market value = 80 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_market_tier = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_market value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_market_tier = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_market value = 40 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_market_tier = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_market value = 20 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_market_tier = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_market value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_market_tier = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_arms value = 80 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_arms_tier = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_arms value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_arms_tier = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_arms value = 30 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_arms_tier = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_arms value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_arms_tier = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bar_market = global.mdcw_cw_market }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bar_market = 3 }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bar_market = 300 }
	round_variable = global.mdcw_cw_bar_market
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bar_arms = global.mdcw_cw_arms }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bar_arms = 3 }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bar_arms = 300 }
	round_variable = global.mdcw_cw_bar_arms
	mdcw_cw_update_tension_display = yes
	mdcw_cw_update_oil_display = yes
}
# Global. Oil values of the Cold War tooltips in dollars of the day (global.imp_oil_price_unit,
# kept by the Imperia oil system: 1.80 / 75 x OPEC price level x consumer prices in 1970).
mdcw_cw_update_oil_display = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_unit = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.imp_oil_price_unit }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_unit = global.imp_oil_price_unit }
	}
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_premium_display = global.mdcw_cw_oil_premium }
	multiply_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_oil_premium_display = mdcw_cw_t_unit }
}
# Country scope. Market effects scale with Imperia Globalism (market exposure = Globalism / 50);
# arms demand and the political climate apply to everyone.
mdcw_cw_update_world_market = {
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_trade = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_roi = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_interest = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_stab = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_war_sup = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_equip = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_prod_growth = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_consumer = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_office = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_mil_income = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_civ_tax = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_inv_cost = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_arms_sales = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_metals = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_exposure = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = globalism_value }
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_exposure = globalism_value }
		divide_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_exposure = 50 }
		clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure min = 0 max = 2 }
	}
	# National idea Export-Led Industrialisation: crises on the world market hit harder
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_exp = 1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_exp = modifier@mdcw_cw_market_exposure }
	multiply_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_exposure = mdcw_cw_t_exp }
	clamp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure min = 0 max = 2.5 }
	# Market Confidence
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_market value = 80 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.08 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_office = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.005 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_roi = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.02 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_prod_growth = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.03 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_civ_tax = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.25 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_interest = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.02 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_consumer = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_market value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.03 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_office = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.002 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_roi = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.1 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_interest = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_market value = 40 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.04 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_office = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.0025 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_roi = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.01 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_prod_growth = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.05 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_inv_cost = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.1 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_interest = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_market value = 20 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.1 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_office = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.0075 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_roi = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.03 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_prod_growth = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.03 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_civ_tax = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.02 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_stab = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.1 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_inv_cost = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_war_sup = 0.02 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_market value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.2 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_office = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.015 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_roi = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.06 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_prod_growth = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.06 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_civ_tax = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.05 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_stab = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = 0.5 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_interest = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = -0.15 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_fx = mdcw_cw_wm_exposure }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_inv_cost = mdcw_cw_t_fx }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_war_sup = 0.04 }
	}
	# Arms Demand
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_arms value = 80 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_arms_sales = 0.12 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_mil_income = 0.12 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_equip = 0.08 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_metals = 0.06 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_arms value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_arms_sales = 0.08 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_mil_income = 0.08 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_equip = 0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_metals = 0.04 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_arms value = 30 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_arms_sales = 0.04 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_mil_income = 0.04 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_equip = 0.02 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_metals = 0.02 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_arms value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_arms_sales = -0.04 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_equip = -0.02 }
	}
	# Political climate (Cold War Tension)
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_tension value = 80 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_war_sup = 0.06 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_stab = -0.03 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_trade = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_consumer = 0.02 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_tension value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_war_sup = 0.03 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_stab = -0.01 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_trade = -0.05 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_tension value = 40 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		# no effect at this level
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_tension value = 20 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_trade = 0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_war_sup = -0.02 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_tension value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_trade = 0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_stab = 0.01 }
		add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_wm_war_sup = -0.04 }
	}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

### Imperia sanctions ###
# Hook in the Imperia sanction actions (imp_sanctions_diplomatic_actions.txt).
# THIS = sanctioned country, ROOT = sanctioning country, temp mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type:
# 1 diplomatic, 2 financial, 3 economic, 4 military. The sanction itself is done by Imperia.
mdcw_cw_on_sanction_imposed = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
			has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
			ROOT = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
		}
		# A sanction between two opposing blocs raises Cold War Tension.
		if = {
			limit = { ROOT = { mdcw_cw_opposing_to_prev = yes } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 0.1 }
				mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 0.5 }
				mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 0.5 }
				mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 4 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 0.25 }
				mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
			}
		}
		# A bloc leader sanctions a country outside its bloc: the bloc is called to an embargo.
		if = {
			limit = {
				ROOT = {
					mdcw_cw_is_bloc_leader = yes
					check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 }
				}
				NOT = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 1 } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b1_t1 days = 365 value = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 2 } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b1_t2 days = 365 value = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 3 } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b1_t3 days = 365 value = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 4 } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b1_t4 days = 365 value = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 1 } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b2_t1 days = 365 value = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 2 } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b2_t2 days = 365 value = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 3 } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b2_t3 days = 365 value = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 4 } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b2_t4 days = 365 value = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 } }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 1 } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b3_t1 days = 365 value = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 2 } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b3_t2 days = 365 value = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 3 } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b3_t3 days = 365 value = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 4 } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b3_t4 days = 365 value = 1 }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_embargo_target = THIS.id }
			ROOT = {
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						is_ai = no
						has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
						check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment }
						NOT = { tag = ROOT }
					}
					set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev10_partner = ROOT.id }
					set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev10_target = mdcw_cw_t_embargo_target }
					set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev10_type = mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type }
					country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.10 }
				}
			}
		}
		# A member follows its bloc leader's embargo: the leader is grateful.
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				ROOT = { NOT = { mdcw_cw_is_bloc_leader = yes } }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 }
						check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 1 }
						has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b1_t1
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 }
						check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 2 }
						has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b1_t2
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 }
						check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 3 }
						has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b1_t3
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 }
						check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 4 }
						has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b1_t4
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 }
						check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 1 }
						has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b2_t1
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 }
						check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 2 }
						has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b2_t2
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 }
						check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 3 }
						has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b2_t3
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 }
						check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 4 }
						has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b2_t4
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 }
						check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 1 }
						has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b3_t1
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 }
						check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 2 }
						has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b3_t2
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 }
						check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 3 }
						has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b3_t3
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 }
						check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 4 }
						has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b3_t4
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 }
					country_exists = USA
				}
				USA = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_solidarity } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 }
					country_exists = SOV
				}
				SOV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_solidarity } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 }
					country_exists = CHI
				}
				CHI = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = mdcw_cw_bloc_solidarity } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Hook in the Imperia lift actions. Same scopes. A bloc leader lifting its own sanction ends the call.
mdcw_cw_on_sanction_lifted = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
			ROOT = { mdcw_cw_is_bloc_leader = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 1 }
				has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b1_t1
			}
			clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b1_t1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 2 }
				has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b1_t2
			}
			clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b1_t2
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 3 }
				has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b1_t3
			}
			clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b1_t3
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 4 }
				has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b1_t4
			}
			clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b1_t4
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 1 }
				has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b2_t1
			}
			clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b2_t1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 2 }
				has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b2_t2
			}
			clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b2_t2
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 3 }
				has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b2_t3
			}
			clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b2_t3
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 4 }
				has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b2_t4
			}
			clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b2_t4
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 1 }
				has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b3_t1
			}
			clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b3_t1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 2 }
				has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b3_t2
			}
			clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b3_t2
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 3 }
				has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b3_t3
			}
			clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b3_t3
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 }
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_sanc_type = 4 }
				has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b3_t4
			}
			clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_embargo_b3_t4
		}
	}
}

### Decisions ###
# Country scope. A loan of 2% of GDP: the money arrives now, the same amount is added to debt.
mdcw_cw_take_loan = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_loan = gdp_total }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_loan = 0.02 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = mdcw_cw_t_loan min = 0.5 max = 25 }
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = mdcw_cw_t_loan }
	modify_treasury_effect = yes
	set_temp_variable = { debt_change = mdcw_cw_t_loan }
	modify_debt_effect = yes
}

# Country scope (a bloc leader). Pairs with a detente initiative of another bloc leader
# taken in the last days, otherwise leaves an open offer.
mdcw_cw_detente_initiative = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_detente_offer_2
				country_exists = SOV
			}
			clr_global_flag = mdcw_cw_detente_offer_2
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = -5 }
			mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
			add_timed_idea = { idea = mdcw_cw_detente_agreement days = 365 }
			SOV = {
				add_timed_idea = { idea = mdcw_cw_detente_agreement days = 365 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_ev12_a = THIS.id }
			SOV = { set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_ev12_b = THIS.id } }
			every_country = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev12_a = mdcw_cw_t_ev12_a }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev12_b = mdcw_cw_t_ev12_b }
				country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.12 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_detente_offer_3
				country_exists = CHI
			}
			clr_global_flag = mdcw_cw_detente_offer_3
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = -5 }
			mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
			add_timed_idea = { idea = mdcw_cw_detente_agreement days = 365 }
			CHI = {
				add_timed_idea = { idea = mdcw_cw_detente_agreement days = 365 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_ev12_a = THIS.id }
			CHI = { set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_ev12_b = THIS.id } }
			every_country = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev12_a = mdcw_cw_t_ev12_a }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev12_b = mdcw_cw_t_ev12_b }
				country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.12 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_global_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_detente_offer_1 days = 90 value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_detente_offer_1
				country_exists = USA
			}
			clr_global_flag = mdcw_cw_detente_offer_1
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = -5 }
			mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
			add_timed_idea = { idea = mdcw_cw_detente_agreement days = 365 }
			USA = {
				add_timed_idea = { idea = mdcw_cw_detente_agreement days = 365 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_ev12_a = THIS.id }
			USA = { set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_ev12_b = THIS.id } }
			every_country = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev12_a = mdcw_cw_t_ev12_a }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev12_b = mdcw_cw_t_ev12_b }
				country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.12 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_detente_offer_3
				country_exists = CHI
			}
			clr_global_flag = mdcw_cw_detente_offer_3
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = -5 }
			mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
			add_timed_idea = { idea = mdcw_cw_detente_agreement days = 365 }
			CHI = {
				add_timed_idea = { idea = mdcw_cw_detente_agreement days = 365 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_ev12_a = THIS.id }
			CHI = { set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_ev12_b = THIS.id } }
			every_country = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev12_a = mdcw_cw_t_ev12_a }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev12_b = mdcw_cw_t_ev12_b }
				country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.12 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_global_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_detente_offer_2 days = 90 value = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_detente_offer_1
				country_exists = USA
			}
			clr_global_flag = mdcw_cw_detente_offer_1
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = -5 }
			mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
			add_timed_idea = { idea = mdcw_cw_detente_agreement days = 365 }
			USA = {
				add_timed_idea = { idea = mdcw_cw_detente_agreement days = 365 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_ev12_a = THIS.id }
			USA = { set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_ev12_b = THIS.id } }
			every_country = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev12_a = mdcw_cw_t_ev12_a }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev12_b = mdcw_cw_t_ev12_b }
				country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.12 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_detente_offer_2
				country_exists = SOV
			}
			clr_global_flag = mdcw_cw_detente_offer_2
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = -5 }
			mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
			add_timed_idea = { idea = mdcw_cw_detente_agreement days = 365 }
			SOV = {
				add_timed_idea = { idea = mdcw_cw_detente_agreement days = 365 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_ev12_a = THIS.id }
			SOV = { set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_ev12_b = THIS.id } }
			every_country = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev12_a = mdcw_cw_t_ev12_a }
				set_variable = { mdcw_cw_ev12_b = mdcw_cw_t_ev12_b }
				country_event = { id = mdcw_cw.12 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_global_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_detente_offer_3 days = 90 value = 1 }
		}
	}
	mdcw_cw_touch_gui = yes
}

# Global. Remaining days of the leader programmes (for the interface).
mdcw_cw_update_programme_days = {
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bp_left_1 = global.mdcw_cw_bp_until_1 }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bp_left_1 = global.num_days }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_bp_left_1 min = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bp_left_2 = global.mdcw_cw_bp_until_2 }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bp_left_2 = global.num_days }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_bp_left_2 min = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bp_left_3 = global.mdcw_cw_bp_until_3 }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_bp_left_3 = global.num_days }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.mdcw_cw_bp_left_3 min = 0 }
}

# on_war_relation_added: ROOT = attacker, FROM = defender.
mdcw_cw_on_war_relation = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			ROOT = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 } }
			FROM = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = FROM.mdcw_cw_alignment } }
		}
		# on_war_relation_added fires once per pair of enemies (every ally that joins),
		# so each kind of shock counts at most once per 30 days.
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					ROOT = { OR = { original_tag = USA original_tag = SOV original_tag = CHI } }
					FROM = { OR = { original_tag = USA original_tag = SOV original_tag = CHI } }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_leader_war_shock } }
				set_global_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_leader_war_shock days = 30 value = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 8 }
				mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_bloc_war_shock } }
			set_global_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_bloc_war_shock days = 30 value = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 4 }
			mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
		}
	}
	# Programmes between enemies are frozen, never silently continued.
	FROM = { ROOT = { mdcw_cw_suspend_links_with_prev = yes } }
	ROOT = { FROM = { mdcw_cw_suspend_links_with_prev = yes } }
}

# on_send_volunteers: ROOT = sender, FROM = receiver.
mdcw_cw_on_volunteers = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			ROOT = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 } }
			FROM = {
				any_enemy_country = {
					check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 }
					NOT = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment } }
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 2 }
		mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
	}
}

# on_coup_succeeded: ROOT = country that changed government, FROM = coup sponsor.
mdcw_cw_on_coup = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			FROM = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 } }
			ROOT = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 0 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.mdcw_cw_alignment = FROM.mdcw_cw_alignment } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 2 }
		mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
	}
}
